narrative.intro: Techflow obligated $310M in FY2026 to date across three awards, with an average award size of $103M. Techflow obligations were up 26.6% year over year. Techflow has a history of multi-year activity, with fiscal-year totals ranging from $193M in FY21 to $310M in FY26. The Department of Homeland Security is Techflow's dominant buyer, accounting for $310M in obligations for the current fiscal year to date. Techflow's primary market is Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance, which also accounts for $310M of FY2026 obligations. Techflow has smaller activity in Custom Computer Programming Services and Security Guards and Patrol Services, with $347K and $5K in obligations respectively. The current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the figures presented are contract obligations except for award-value fields noted elsewhere as total contract values. These figures show where Techflow is concentrated by customer and NAICS market in the ongoing fiscal year, and they highlight the scale and concentration of Techflow business with a single federal agency and a single market segment.
